_comment: Model choice is configuration, never code. Override provider with env QA_MODEL_PROVIDER. No automatic fallback between providers.

grok._comment: xAI Chat Completions (OpenAI-compatible) POST {base_url}/chat/completions with response_format json_schema strict. Disabled until Milestone B2 approval. Prices MUST be entered from the xAI console/models page (USD per 1M tokens); null => refuses to run.
grok._egress_comment: Approved external model hosts live in config/policy.json tools.model.request.approved_hosts (separate from this base_url). Non-loopback endpoints must use https.

budget._comment: PROPOSED caps for the B2 live eval (not an approved authorization). total_usd is persisted per scope across runs and days; the xAI Console spend limit is a separate provider-side prerequisite.

auth._comment: demo = unauthenticated approver label (local demo only). local = hashed bearer tokens from users_file with roles viewer/requester/approver. Neither is SSO.

unattended_eval_approval._comment: Synthetic-eval harness only. Requires a signed authorization file (see docs/b2/UNATTENDED_EVAL_AUTHORIZATION.template.json). Normal approvals are unaffected.
